content.rationale: S2-resolve fixes that an edge target resolves to a sibling node document at the change the id names (D1b), files alone, never parentage; S2-root fixes the one exception — zzzzzzzz names the root and no file; S2-resolve-load fixes that resolution yields the loaded document, not the path; D3 names that id and D4 fixes sibling resolution. It loads through node_load (which reads through M-store-read) and names ids through store_path, reaching the runner (M-jj, zruxtxrv) through the read; which edge kinds may carry the root stays with the contract level (D3, D4). I1-serde (`orrvsxqq`) fixes the JSON layer the module is written against — serde and serde_json, the crate's own `Value` and the derive. The module also implements S2-resolve-in-set (`opqlqqvu`): `resolve_in` is the set-backed entry point, taking a lookup the caller supplies, so the same resolution rule answers from a set already read without a second path.
